title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28
source: Recording Info: SBD > Master Reels > .wav 24-bit/96k (Master Reels transferred by Rob Eaton); Mastering Info: .wav 24-bit/96k > Adobe Audition 3.0 24/96 > TLH > flac2496; 24-bit > 16-bit via dBpoweramp

ai_review.summary: Remastered soundboard capture of an incredible 1973 show, featuring a smoking “Playing in the Band” jam and a wild Good Lovin’ sequence with crystal‑clear instrument separation.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the superb remastering that delivers excellent fidelity and clear instrument separation. The performance shines especially on the extended “Playin'” jam and an explosive Good Lovin’ segment, while Bill’s drumming and the tight rhythm section keep the energy high throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star, praising both the musical performance and the high‑quality soundboard recording; no criticisms were noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered from a .sbd source with crystal‑clear instrument separation, great audio fidelity, and only minor pitch‑correction mentions that do not detract from overall quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly with high energy, building into a standout Playin' jam and an adventurous Good Lovin' segment that keep momentum strong.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highlighted for dynamic tempo shifts and pushing the band during the Good Lovin' jam; overall guitar work praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for crazy riffs, melodic bursts, and zip‑in/out lines throughout the Playin' jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Commended for wicked funk picking early in the Playin' jam (right channel).
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's drumming described as laying down a solid, tight groove that anchors the performance.
